summary: Iteration 42 — 9434-3977 QC inc. — Validation of 2 new features requested by user (French): (A) Extourne (Reversal) MUST PRESERVE the original invoice entry and POST an inverse entry (source='reversal'), never delete/modify the original; (B) AccountDetailModal (drill-down) MUST have a search bar (data-testid='qc-detail-search') that filters rows + a scope toggle (data-testid='qc-detail-scope-toggle') between 'Exercice {year}' (movement) and 'Cumulatif' (cumulative). Both features validated end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest phase8, 7/7 PASSED): (1) test_reversal_preserves_original_and_posts_inverse — created TEST_Phase8 invoice, called POST /api/qc9434/invoices/{iid}/reverse, GET /api/qc9434/entries confirmed BOTH the original entry (source='invoice', reference=invoice number) AND the reversal entry (source='reversal', description containing 'Extourne') coexist ✔, and invoice status → 'reversed' ✔ ; (2) test_reversal_blocked_when_paid — invoice with encaissement partiel returns HTTP 400 with detail mentioning 'note de crédit' ✔ ; (3) test_double_reversal_blocked — second reverse on already-reversed invoice returns HTTP 400 'déjà extournée' ✔ ; (4) test_movement_scope — /api/qc9434/account-detail?scope=movement returns rows with year==2026 only ✔ ; (5) test_cumulative_scope_includes_prior_and_current — scope=cumulative returns rows with year<=2026 ✔ ; (6) test_cumulative_row_count_ge_movement — cumulative row count ≥ movement row count ✔ ; (7) test_account_detail_default_scope_is_movement — default scope is 'movement' ✔. FRONTEND (admin@accslegro.com, 1920x1080): (a) Login → nav-acct_qc9434 → QC entity loaded ✔ ; (b) Balance de vérification tab, clicked qc-tb-row-100110 → qc-account-detail-modal opened ✔ ; (c) qc-detail-search filter tested: typing 'ZZZZZ_no_match_xyz' → qc-detail-no-match row displayed AND modal text contains 'TOTAL FILTRÉ' ✔ ; (d) qc-detail-scope-cumulative clicked → HTTP request with scope=cumulative fired (verified via network capture) AND modal description switched to 'Écritures cumulatives jusqu'à la fin de l'exercice' ✔ ; (e) qc-detail-scope-movement clicked → description switched back to 'Écritures de l'exercice {year}' ✔ ; (f) Reversal UI: navigated to Factures clients tab, qc-reverse-dialog opened correctly when clicking qc-invoice-reverse-<id>, cancelled without pollution ✔. All specified data-testids present and functional.

minor.issue: These endpoints expect `year`/`amount`/`date` as QUERY parameters, not JSON body. Non-standard for POST endpoints — a future client sending JSON body will get 422 Unprocessable Entity. Consider accepting both, or migrate to Pydantic body models (QcReceiveIn, QcReverseIn) for consistency with QcInvoiceIn.

action_items: Optional: harmonise POST endpoints for QC 9434 invoices to accept JSON body (Pydantic models) instead of query params — improves API DX and future-proofs frontend refactors.

Observation (not blocking): the pre-existing invoice 2026-001 (Bikuma Bindanda) is 'reversed' but its original entry (source='invoice', reference='2026-001') is MISSING from /api/qc9434/entries — only entry 2026-0012 (source='reversal', reference='2026-001') exists. This is LEGACY data from a reversal executed BEFORE the current 'preserve original' logic was added, or from a prior purge that dropped the source_id entry. The current code (server.py:5616-5644) correctly preserves the original — confirmed by pytest test_reversal_preserves_original_and_posts_inverse. Main agent may want to backfill/audit this legacy row if it needs to reconcile Balance TB.
critical_code_review_comments: QcEntity.js is now ~1861 lines — split into /app/frontend/src/pages/qc9434/ subfolder overdue (mentioned in iteration 41 too).

qc_reverse_invoice (server.py:5616-5644) correctly uses `_qc_post_entry(..., source='reversal', source_id=iid, ...)` and only mutates status/credited_amount/reversed_at on the original invoice doc — original entry document is NEVER touched. ✔

qc_account_detail (server.py:6106-6124) correctly handles scope: `q['year'] = {'$lte': int(year)} if scope=='cumulative' else int(year)` — clean, minimal, and excludes 'closing' entries. Running balance is computed per-row. ✔

AccountDetailModal.jsx: query filter uses `[r.num, r.date, r.description, r.tiers, money(r.debit), money(r.credit), money(r.balance)].join(' ').toLowerCase()` — will match on formatted currency strings (' 1 234,56 ') which is what user expects. ✔

Minor: filtered totals (fDebit/fCredit) are recomputed from filtered rows but the 'balance' column in the TFOOT still shows the UNFILTERED d.balance (line 317) — this is intentional per code but arguably confusing when a filter is active (should ideally show the running balance of the last visible row or a sub-total). Very minor UX polish.
POST endpoints using query params for structured data (year, amount, date) is an anti-pattern — see minor backend issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI assertions pass on public URL)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest fixture creates client 'TEST_Phase8_Reversal' + 3 invoices for reversal tests, purged by autouse module teardown calling POST /api/qc9434/purge-test-data. No residual TEST_ data after test run (verified via API: purge returned deleted=0 clients/0 invoices post-test). UI flow only cancelled the reverse dialog — no data mutations from UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested features (reversal preserves original + drill-down search & scope toggle) are FULLY WORKING backend+frontend. Note that POST /api/qc9434/invoices, /receive, /reverse use QUERY params (year, amount, date), not JSON body — future tests must use `params=` not `json=` for those fields. Legacy invoice 2026-001 has orphaned reversal entry (no original) — reproducible via GET /api/qc9434/entries?year=2026; not caused by current code. QcEntity.js file is ~1861 lines and still due for a split.
rca of the issue: N/A — both features working as specified. Only latent observation: legacy invoice 2026-001 has an orphaned reversal entry (2026-0012) with no matching source='invoice' entry. RCA: this invoice was reversed under an older code path OR the source='invoice' entry was purged manually. Reproduction: GET /api/qc9434/entries?year=2026 → 12 entries, none with source='invoice' and reference='2026-001', but one with source='reversal' and reference='2026-001'. Mitigation: main agent can either backfill the original entry from the invoice's stored `items` array (invoice doc still exists with total=11497.50) or simply delete the orphaned reversal entry 2026-0012 to keep TB balanced. Not blocking the release since current code prevents recurrence.
